'''Alli Krieger's sister''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. She was a sister of [[Alli Krieger]], a small business owner in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] and [[Erek Krieger]], [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alli Krieger's sister is mentioned in the letter Alli sends to the player.<ref name="Mail">{{TORcite|type=message|My brother the private.|Alli Krieger}}</ref>

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1stm}}
